# Inspector E2E agent (`inspector-e2e`)

Unified Rasa CALM assistant for next-gen Inspector Playwright tests: finance banking flows plus inspector diagnostics, Context7, and DeepWiki integrations.

## Layout

- `config.yml` — `assistant_id: inspector-e2e`, `flow_retrieval.active: false`
- `endpoints.yml` — mock MCP at `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp`, NLG rephraser, model groups
- `credentials.yml` — `inspector` channel (Deepgram ASR/TTS)
- `sub_agents/` — `deepwiki_github`, `library_docs`, `inspector_toolbox`
- `actions/inspector.py` — `action_inspector_raise_failure`
- `docs/E2E_TRIGGERS.md` — E2E test trigger reference (also shown in welcome/help)

No `tests/e2e_test_cases/` — Playwright in `../tests/` is the E2E layer.

## Environment

| Variable | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | Yes | LLM / embeddings / rephraser |
| `RASA_PRO_LICENSE` | Yes | Rasa Pro |
| `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY` | Yes | Voice (inspector channel) |

Start the mock MCP before train/inspect (see `../mock-mcp/README.md`). `yarn e2e` from `../` starts mock + Rasa automatically.

## Commands

From repo root with `.venv` activated:

```bash
# Mock MCP (terminal 1)
python rasa/core/channels/inspector-nextgen/e2e/mock-mcp/server.py

# Agent (terminal 2)
cd rasa/core/channels/inspector-nextgen/e2e/agent
rasa data validate --endpoints endpoints.yml
rasa train
rasa inspect --port 5005
```

Or from `e2e/`: `yarn e2e:setup` to train and run the agent along with the mock MCP followed by `yarn e2e:only` to run the tests.
